passages.text: Our class plans a recorded interview with a clock repairer for the school radio show. Ben can tell time on the large classroom clock, but he wants to understand clocks without numbers. We telephone the repairer during lunch, when she is helping a customer in her shop. She says she will ring us back after the repair is safely finished. While waiting, we choose three clear questions and test the recorder with the teacher. Her later call gives us enough quiet time to discuss how different clock faces show the same information.

parallelText.en: Our class plans a recorded interview with a clock repairer for the school radio show.
parallelText.zh: 我们班计划为校园广播录制一次钟表修理师采访。

parallelText.en: Ben can tell time on the large classroom clock, but he wants to understand clocks without numbers.
parallelText.zh: 本能看教室的大钟报时，但他想理解没有数字的钟。

parallelText.en: We telephone the repairer during lunch, when she is helping a customer in her shop.
parallelText.zh: 午休时我们打电话，她正忙着帮助店里的顾客。

parallelText.en: She says she will ring us back after the repair is safely finished.
parallelText.zh: 她说等安全完成维修后会给我们回电话。

parallelText.en: While waiting, we choose three clear questions and test the recorder with the teacher.
parallelText.zh: 等待时，我们选好三个明确问题，并和老师测试录音机。

parallelText.en: Her later call gives us enough quiet time to discuss how different clock faces show the same information.
parallelText.zh: 她稍后回电，让我们有足够安静时间讨论不同钟面如何显示相同信息。

passages.text: Our community art club wants an experienced visitor to give lessons to beginners during the school holiday. Mia offers to ring her up with the club leader beside her to explain the plan. Before calling, they write down the number of learners and the materials already available. The visitor asks whether the room has tables that can be cleaned easily after painting. We check with the caretaker and send a clear answer before agreeing on the first date. Planning the practical details helps the guest decide what she can teach and what equipment she should bring.

parallelText.en: Our community art club wants an experienced visitor to give lessons to beginners during the school holiday.
parallelText.zh: 社区美术社希望一位有经验的来访者在学校假期给初学者上课。

parallelText.en: Mia offers to ring her up with the club leader beside her to explain the plan.
parallelText.zh: 米娅提出在社团负责人陪同下给她打电话，说明计划。

parallelText.en: Before calling, they write down the number of learners and the materials already available.
parallelText.zh: 拨打前，她们写下学习人数和现有材料。

parallelText.en: The visitor asks whether the room has tables that can be cleaned easily after painting.
parallelText.zh: 来访者问房间有没有画画后便于清洁的桌子。

parallelText.en: We check with the caretaker and send a clear answer before agreeing on the first date.
parallelText.zh: 我们和管理员核对，明确答复后才商定首次日期。

parallelText.en: Planning the practical details helps the guest decide what she can teach and what equipment she should bring.
parallelText.zh: 计划好实际细节，帮助客人决定能教什么、需要带什么器材。
